verification_standard.verified_here: Identifier, title/attribution/date where legible, document role, selected source passages and observed endpoint behaviour.
verification_standard.not_verified: Complete scan authenticity, official-to-mirror byte identity, handwritten markings, every experiment, raw data, reproduction rights or exhaustive corpus coverage.
verification_standard.retrieval_method: Public web retrieval and official search-indexed excerpts; current repository and website source inspection.
verification_standard.pdf_page_convention: 1-based file pages, including inserted wrapper pages; printed page labels recorded separately. Counts refer to these specific files, not a universal report edition.
verification_standard.screenshot_limitation: Screenshot retrieval did not provide inspectable image pixels in this environment; conclusions rely on available text/OCR. No handwriting, redaction recovery or visual completeness judgement is made.
verification_standard.failure_interpretation: A redirect or failed retrieval is an environment/date-specific observation, not proof that the document no longer exists or is unavailable to everyone.
verification_standard.http_status_codes: Not recorded where the retrieval tool did not expose them.
